title: 第4章 智脑启动
content_zh:
“难道是因为前几天中暑，摔在了地上，所以摔坏了脑袋？”季枫对于自己的变化，有些难以置信！

整个上午，季枫都处在震惊之中，为了证实之前的那一幕究竟是不是自己的幻觉，他将所有的课本都拿了出来，专门挑还没有学过的内容看。

看完之后，他就立刻合上书，不再多看一眼。等到片刻之后，他再开始在心中背诵。

结果让他既震惊又欣喜若狂，哪怕是最复杂的英文单词或者是从来没有学过的推理公式，他都能够清晰的回忆起来，并且说的一字不差！

经过反复的验证，季枫发现，之前的一幕并不是自己的幻觉，而是事实！

季枫呆呆的看着课本，心中一阵狂喜，“自己真的有了过目不忘的本事！”

季枫很快又疑惑了起来，他可是知道自己的能力，平时背诵一篇课文都要几天的时间，跟现在比简直是天壤之别。

想了半天也没有想出个所以然来，季枫只能摇了摇头，不再去想，心中却是暗暗窃喜。

拥有了过目不忘的本事，这也就意味着，在接下来的一年里，他完全可以将过去落下的功课全部补上，能够考上一所很不错的大学！

甚至于，还能够做很多以前想做而做不到的事情……过目不忘的能力，绝对不只是用来考大学这么简单！

季枫想到兴奋的地方，不由的抓了抓脑袋，脸色也兴奋的微微发红。

旁边的张磊顿时疑惑的问道：“我说疯子，你今天怎么这么反常？……该不会是真的疯了吧？”

季枫瞪了他一眼，笑骂道：“你疯了我都不会疯！”

“还能骂人，就代表是正常的，还好，还好！”张磊长出了一口气，呵呵笑道：“说真的，我还真怕你受不了打击，心里出现什么问题。疯子，胡雪慧那个势利的女人，不值得你为她伤心！”

季枫听的出来，张磊的关心是真诚的，心中不禁流过一道暖流，摇头笑道：“磊子，你说的没错，那样的女人，不值得我为她伤心。所以，我已经把她给忘记了！”

在医院看到母亲的泪水的那一刻开始，季枫就已经决定，要把胡雪慧给忘记，即便是偶尔想起，那也只是再平常不过的一段回忆罢了，没有任何特殊的意义！

他习惯性的朝着前面扫了一眼，最后落到了已经调到前面几排的胡雪慧，想起以前自己的痴傻，忍不住摇头一笑。

所幸的是，胡雪慧早早的提出了分手，也让季枫早早的醒悟了。若非如此的话，季枫还不知道会沉迷多久，甚至会误了他的一生也说不定。

看着那曾经无比熟悉的背影，季枫十分平静，只是心中在暗下决心：“莫欺少年穷啊！既然你那么喜欢钱，那我就去努力的挣钱，一直到钱多的数不过来。只不过，我却不是为了让你后悔，也不是为了赌气，而是为了我的母亲。我要让那些曾经耻笑她，蔑视她的人，都追悔莫及。但是这一切，与你胡雪慧，已经没有任何关系了……”

再次深深的看了一眼胡雪慧的背影，季枫干脆的收回了目光，从此之后，两人便是陌路人，哪怕擦肩而过，也不会再相识！

似乎是感觉到了背后的目光，坐在第三排的胡雪慧回头望去，却见季枫正脸色平静的低头看书，时而眉头紧锁，时而脸带笑容，似乎很是投入。

她不屑的撇撇嘴，一个穷鬼，再怎么努力又有什么用，就算考上大学，能上的起吗？

下午的时间过的波澜不惊，很快便到了放学的时间。因为是开学第一天，所以并没有上晚自习，季枫婉拒了张磊要在海鲜酒楼请客的邀请，便准备离开学校！

在季枫看来，朋友之间，哪怕一个安慰的眼神，就已经足够。张磊能够几次安慰他，就已经是最好的接风礼物了。

张磊也知道季枫的脾气，也就没有多说什么。

两人分别之后，季枫一路小跑回到家里，母亲肖素梅正在厨房中忙活着。

“妈，我回来了！”季枫喊了一声。

肖素梅从厨房中探出头，顿时满脸的笑容，“枫儿，先去上楼吧，妈再炒一个菜就好了！”

季枫本想去帮忙，但是看了看已经挤满了人的厨房，只能点头，笑道：“那我去了！”

季枫母子现在住的房子，在邙石县的老城区。这里的房子，都是一些私人自建的民房，大多都是三四层的楼房，没有阳台，就好像那些简陋的旅社一样，房门并排相连，对着走廊。

这里的房子大多都是出租的，比如季枫现在住的这栋楼，大多都是一些低收入的人居住的，比如二楼的张伯是收破烂的，在季枫小的时候，母亲肖素梅捡了废品之后，就卖给张伯。

再比如一楼的王阿姨，就是和肖素梅一样，都是小菜贩。

因为房东在院子里设了一个公用的厨房，以及大的洗手间，所以一到做饭的时候，所有人都会挤到一起，彼此倒也都十分的熟识。

来这里租房的人，除了房东以为几乎都是穷人，干的也都是社会最底层的工作，所以大家也都十分的和气，有时候也会互相帮忙，倒也是别有一番温馨。

季枫母子租的房子在三楼，原本是一个大房间，但是因为季枫长大了，肖素梅就让房东给隔开了，平时外面的房间当客厅，晚上的时候，这里就是季枫的卧室，吃饭的餐桌就变成了他的书桌，劣质的沙发也就变成了他的单人床！

坐在沙发上，季枫有些犹豫，不知道该不该把自己身上发生的变化告诉母亲。

思虑半晌之后，季枫还是决定暂且先不告诉母亲，还是等到高考结束之后，再给母亲一个惊喜吧！

想到母亲那开心的模样，季枫不禁露出了笑容。

“枫儿，下来帮忙端菜！”母亲肖素梅的声音忽然传了过来。

在肖素梅的用心准备下，四菜一汤的晚饭时分的丰盛，看着儿子那狼吞虎咽的模样，肖素梅开心极了。

躺在床上，季枫却没有半点睡意，任何人在突然拥有了神奇的能力之后，也绝对不会那么平静。

“有了过目不忘的本事，考大学肯定没问题了，但是，这种能力能维持多久呢？会不会过几天就没有了？”

季枫的脑海中胡思乱想着，直到深夜，他才算是有了睡意，迷迷糊糊的进入了梦乡。

就在这时，他的脑海中，突然响起了一道仿佛合成音一般的声音：“与宿主彻底融合完毕，智脑一号，启动！”

content_en:
"Is it because I had a heat stroke a few days ago and fell to the ground, so I broke my head?" Ji Feng was a little unbelievable about his changes!

Ji Feng was in shock throughout the morning. In order to confirm whether the previous scene was his hallucination, he took out all the textbooks and specifically selected the content that he had not learned yet.

After reading it, he immediately closed the book and didn't look at it again.After a while, he began to recite it in his mind.

The result shocked and delighted him. Even the most complicated English words or reasoning formulas he had never learned before, he could clearly recall and speak them word for word!

After repeated verifications, Ji Feng discovered that the previous scene was not his hallucination, but fact!

Ji Feng looked at the textbook blankly, feeling ecstatic in his heart, "I really have the ability to have a photographic memory!"

Ji Feng soon became confused again. He knew his ability. It usually took him several days to recite a text. Compared with now, it was a huge difference.

After thinking for a long time, he still couldn't figure out the reason. Ji Feng could only shake his head and stop thinking about it, but he was secretly happy in his heart.

Having a photographic memory means that in the next year, he can make up for all the homework he missed in the past and be admitted to a very good university!

Even, you can do many things that you wanted to do but couldn't do before... The ability of photographic memory is definitely not just for college entrance exams!

Ji Feng couldn't help but scratch his head when he thought about the excitement, and his face turned slightly red with excitement.

Zhang Lei, who was standing next to him, suddenly asked in confusion: "I said crazy, why are you so abnormal today?... Could you be really crazy?"

Ji Feng glared at him and cursed with a smile: "I won't be crazy even if you are crazy!"

"You can still curse people, which means it's normal. It's okay, it's okay!" Zhang Lei let out a long breath and laughed: "To be honest, I'm really afraid that you can't bear the blow and have some problems in your heart. Madman, that snobbish woman Hu Xuehui is not worth your sadness for her!"

Ji Feng could tell that Zhang Lei's concern was sincere, and a warm current flowed through his heart. He shook his head and smiled: "Leizi, you are right, a woman like that is not worth my sadness for her. So, I have forgotten her!"

From the moment he saw his mother's tears in the hospital, Ji Feng had already decided to forget Hu Xuehui. Even if he remembered it occasionally, it was just an ordinary memory without any special meaning!

He glanced ahead as a habit, and finally landed on Hu Xuehui, who had been moved to the front rows. Thinking of his stupidity in the past, he couldn't help but shake his head and smile.

Fortunately, Hu Xuehui proposed breaking up early, which also made Ji Feng wake up early.If not, Ji Feng doesn't know how long he will be addicted to it, and it might even cost him his life.

Looking at the once-very familiar back, Ji Feng was very calm, but secretly made up his mind: "Don't deceive the young man into being poor! Since you like money so much, then I will work hard to make money until the money is too much to count. However, I am not doing it to make you regret, nor to be angry, but for my mother. I want to make those who have ridiculed her and despised her regret it. But all of this has nothing to do with you, Hu Xuehui..."

After taking another deep look at Hu Xuehui's back, Ji Feng simply withdrew his gaze. From then on, the two of them were strangers. Even if they passed each other, they would never know each other again!

As if feeling the gaze from behind, Hu Xuehui, who was sitting in the third row, looked back and saw Ji Feng looking down at a book with a calm face, sometimes frowning, sometimes with a smile on his face, as if he was very involved.

She curled her lips in disdain. As a poor guy, no matter how hard he worked, it was of no use. Even if he was admitted to college, would he be able to afford it?

The afternoon passed uneventfully, and soon it was time for school to end.Since it was the first day of school, he did not study in the evening. Ji Feng declined Zhang Lei's invitation to entertain guests at the seafood restaurant and was about to leave the school!

In Ji Feng's view, even a comforting look between friends is enough.Zhang Lei could comfort him several times, which was already the best gift for him.

Zhang Lei also knew Ji Feng's temper, so he didn't say much.

After the two separated, Ji Feng trotted back home, where his mother Xiao Sumei was busy in the kitchen.

"Mom, I'm back!" Ji Feng shouted.

Xiao Sumei poked her head out of the kitchen, with a smile on her face, "Feng'er, go upstairs first, Mom will just cook another dish!"

Ji Feng originally wanted to help, but after looking at the already crowded kitchen, he could only nod and said with a smile: "Then I'll go!"

The house where Ji Feng's mother and son live now is in the old town of Manshi County.The houses here are all privately built houses. Most of them are three or four-story buildings with no balconies. They are just like those simple hotels. The doors are connected side by side and face the corridor.

Most of the houses here are for rent. For example, the building where Ji Feng lives now is mostly occupied by low-income people. For example, Uncle Zhang on the second floor collects rags. When Ji Feng was young, his mother Xiao Sumei collected the scraps and sold them to Uncle Zhang.

Another example is Aunt Wang on the first floor, who, like Xiao Sumei, is a vegetable vendor.

Because the landlord set up a public kitchen and a large bathroom in the yard, everyone would crowd together when cooking, and they all knew each other very well.

People who rent here, except for the landlord, think that almost all of them are poor and work at the lowest level of society. Therefore, everyone is very friendly and sometimes helps each other, which is quite warm.

The house rented by Ji Feng and his son was on the third floor. It was originally a large room, but as Ji Feng grew up, Xiao Sumei asked the landlord to separate it. Normally, the outside room was used as the living room. At night, this was Ji Feng's bedroom. The dining table became his desk, and the inferior sofa became his single bed!

Sitting on the sofa, Ji Feng hesitated, wondering whether he should tell his mother about the changes that had occurred in him.

After thinking for a long time, Ji Feng decided not to tell his mother for the time being, but to wait until the college entrance examination is over before giving his mother a surprise!

Thinking of his mother's happy appearance, Ji Feng couldn't help but smile.

"Feng'er, come down and help serve the dishes!" Mother Xiao Sumei's voice suddenly came over.

Under Xiao Sumei's careful preparation, the dinner of four dishes and one soup was sumptuous. Seeing her son gobble it up, Xiao Sumei was extremely happy.

Lying on the bed, Ji Feng was not sleepy at all. Anyone who suddenly possesses magical abilities would never be so calm.

"With the ability of photographic memory, it will be no problem to get into college, but how long can this ability last? Will it disappear in a few days?"

Ji Feng's mind was filled with random thoughts, and it wasn't until late at night that he finally fell asleep and fell asleep.

At this moment, a voice that sounded like a synthetic voice suddenly sounded in his mind: "Complete integration with the host, Intelligent Brain No. 1, start!"
